content.value: The vanilla [[item/minecraft:grindstone|Grindstone]] is the [[article/repairing|Repair Bench]]. Choose damaged equipment and inspect the materials required to repair it. The cost grows with the durability that needs restoring.
Repair preserves the equipment and its supported runes, quality and enchantments. This station is not the vanilla disenchanting operation.
The [[article/quality|Upgrade Bench]] handles quality and enchantment-slot upgrades; the [[article/enchantments|Enchanting Table]] manages enchantment application, removal and replacement.
Equipment tooltips show remaining and maximum durability. Replacing or upgrading gear and avoiding durability loss are different from restoring durability already lost.
